note: How each human gate is decided (D-156, D-158, D-172, D-188). HUMAN: you decide every item. AUTO_IF_CLEAN: Continue Automatically decides the items that pass the gate's machine checks and leaves anything flagged for you. Spend gates approve automatically only on a confirmed per-video budget while the video stays at or under its target. Narration Preview and Rough Cut are HUMAN so you hear the narration after the script and over the storyboard (D-172). lanes: a lane's own setting wins over gates. In the Short lane the top on-topic concept is picked for you; in the long-form lane you pick (Two Lanes, D-188). research: claims the evidence policy cannot clear are left out of the script and listed on the script screen; a concept too thin to script is dropped and the next on-topic concept tried. Topic, Script, Final Packaging, visual rights, Final Export and Publish are not listed here and always stay with you.
